headline: One a.m. keeps the lights on.
body: The pavement still holds the day's heat. A bicycle chain ticks past the closed bakery and is gone. Friday has not yet decided what it is.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: low cloud, no moon to argue with

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one taxi idling with its roof light off

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: the pharmacy sign still humming blue
